scenarios.expected: Keyboard traversal reaches a 44px control; Enter and Space open a custom picker, exact hex editing persists, and Done or Escape returns focus.

scenarios.workflow: change settings and restart the owned server
scenarios.expected: Exact server settings and complete saved appearance survive a real restart; local font and compact controls survive browser reload.

scenarios.workflow: change interface language through real keyboard traversal
scenarios.expected: Tab reaches the language group; arrow, Home and End navigation reaches enabled choices with visible focus and correct selected state. Traversal remains an unsaved draft until Save; the chosen language persists after reload.

scenarios.workflow: upload a file whose basename already exists
scenarios.expected: Preserve original bytes until an explicit conflict decision, check replacement identity, and retain a usable recovery path or block unrecoverable replacement.
scenarios.notes: The original defects are fixed in the recorded Files checkpoint. A current execution must still satisfy this whole workflow; passing narrower scenarios does not automatically certify it.

scenarios.workflow: recover from copy and restore collisions on phone
scenarios.expected: The entire failure reason and recovery actions remain visible and reachable; retry preserves both originals until the conflict is resolved.
scenarios.notes: The original defects are fixed in the recorded Files checkpoint. A current execution must still satisfy this whole workflow; passing narrower scenarios does not automatically certify it.

scenarios.workflow: open an empty calendar and search from desktop and phone
scenarios.expected: The empty calendar is usable and its search control remains reachable.

scenarios.workflow: create and edit an overnight event, then reload
scenarios.expected: Start and end retain their separate dates and exact saved values.

scenarios.workflow: open an event by keyboard and move it
scenarios.expected: A visible 44px event target is reachable by Tab and Enter, and the moved event survives reload.

scenarios.workflow: reject a new event save and retry
scenarios.expected: The complete draft and error remain visible; retry creates the intended event and reload preserves it.
The editor reports an unconfirmed save and retains its draft for recovery.
An empty object cannot masquerade as a saved event; the draft remains available.

scenarios.workflow: return an invalid event identifier after save
scenarios.expected: The editor rejects the invalid acknowledgment and allows explicit draft discard or retry.

scenarios.workflow: interrupt transport and attempt repeated saves while a write is pending
scenarios.expected: Input remains recoverable after transport failure and repeated activation cannot create duplicate pending writes.

scenarios.workflow: reject an edit and a delete, then recover
scenarios.expected: A failed edit retains input, a failed delete retains its event context, and successful retry persists after reload.

scenarios.workflow: leave a dirty editor and fail a calendar load
scenarios.expected: Back requires a deliberate discard decision; a failed load shows an error and a reachable retry.

scenarios.workflow: choose event options and dates with keyboard input
scenarios.expected: All-day, weekday, reminder and color choices save and reload correctly; date fields and picker controls fit the viewport and retain focus.

scenarios.workflow: edit recurring events with all, this and following scopes
scenarios.expected: Cancel and failed saves preserve the master; successful scoped edits preserve the intended recurrence origin and occurrence set.

scenarios.workflow: lose the response after a real scoped write and retry
scenarios.expected: The stored occurrence is retained; a conflicting retry preserves the draft without duplicating or removing events. Reload exposes the saved result.
Untouched timestamps retain exact precision and offset; all-day date values stay correct after save and reload.

scenarios.workflow: edit recurring occurrences across daylight-saving changes
scenarios.expected: Local wall time and elapsed duration produce the correct stored start and end instants, with the master and exclusions preserved.

scenarios.workflow: use the shared date picker for countdowns and reminders
scenarios.expected: Date-only countdowns and timezone-aware reminders persist their intended values and remain visible after reload.

scenarios.workflow: inspect available and unavailable languages after save, pane refresh and reload
scenarios.expected: Labels and disabled state match backend catalog eligibility in LTR and RTL; genuinely unavailable languages remain unselectable and unsavable.

scenarios.workflow: fail calendar metadata on cold and populated loads, then save an existing event
scenarios.expected: Events stay visible; unavailable calendar selection is explicit and a prose edit preserves the original saved calendar ID.

scenarios.workflow: retry missing calendar names while an event contains unsaved edits
scenarios.expected: The current editor, draft and dirty state survive; refreshed choices and owner status update without saving input.

scenarios.workflow: recover the event list while checking unrelated request failures
scenarios.expected: Successful recovery clears its stale Plan status; a separately failed task-overlay request keeps a truthful partial status.

scenarios.workflow: operate the shared date picker at constrained widths and visual zoom
scenarios.expected: All seven 44px columns fit, pointer selection works, Tab remains inside the picker and Escape restores focus; visual zoom evidence stays distinct from browser text zoom.
Collision cancellation leaves original bytes and version history unchanged, with focus returned to the upload control.
An explicitly chosen new filename preserves both exact originals and new upload bytes after reload.
Version restore checks current identity, preserves previous bytes, confirms success and survives reload/download.
Replacing an original above 25MiB is refused without modification; a new filename remains available.
Another tab's saved replacement invalidates a stale decision; retry/cancel preserves that saved file.
Restoring over a changed current file requires a new explicit decision; cancel preserves current bytes.
Retrying an accepted upload whose acknowledgment was lost detects identical bytes without a duplicate write/version.
Failed uploads keep the selected File and chosen name; retry saves once after recovery.
A pre-dispatch transport failure remains visible; cancellation does not create a destination.
Full transfer failure reasons wrap and remain readable in both themes; failed copies preserve source and destination.
Every deliberate response/transport fault is individually accounted for, with no unexpected page, request or console errors.
The last populated row and selection controls remain reachable above a retained failed transfer.
Several long transfer failures stay visible without covering the last row in either theme.
At constrained height, retained errors scroll independently while pointer/keyboard access to rows and selection remains available.
Clearing only fixture operations and reloading removes obsolete scroll clearance.
After a successful metrics poll, failed polls visibly mark metrics unavailable and successful recovery updates the status.
Re-entering a previously successful monitor during failure displays recoverable unavailability instead of indefinite loading.
Real owned runtime logs render their saved timestamps beside messages.
A failed log request exposes a local error; retry restores current logs without an unrelated panel being replaced.

Empty provider configuration leaves remote backup actions visibly disabled without making provider requests.
A simulated remote backup rejection appears beside its action and clears in-progress status while allowing retry.
Simulated remote backup success refreshes the visible backup list and retains keyboard focus; reentry preserves the confirmed simulated result.
Actual keyboard/pointer owner confirmation downloads a nonempty encrypted local fixture backup in the expected format.
Stopping and restarting only the disposable server preserves the exact saved policy after fresh authentication.
Long owned log content and panels remain bounded and readable in Light at desktop and phone widths.
Server section controls remain keyboard reachable with focus visible and the selected section correctly displayed.
Browser back and forward preserve the requested Server section and its visible content.

scenarios.workflow: keep the selected Settings section identifiable while traversing navigation

Reach Gallery from Files, inspect the empty state and return through the supported navigation.
